content: Biniyaame Zarkkefe Dawitekko Yida Ola Asata
Dawiti Qiise naa Sa7ooleppe baqatidi Xigilaagen uttida wode izakko yida asati hayssafe kaallizayta; isttika kase iza ola wode iza maaddida ola qarata giddon deettes.
Istti ushachcha kusheninne hadirsa kushen wondafe dukkanaassinne yanbarshe dhayqanaas dandayza olanchchata; isttika Biniyaame zare gidida Sa7ooles asho dabbota.
Istta halaqay Gibi7a as Shama7e naa Ahi7ezeerenne Iyo7aasa. Harati qasse Azimoote naa Yizi7eelenne Paleexe, Baraake, Anatoote as Iyu,
erettida 30 olanchchatas halaqanne erettida olanchcha Geba7oone dere as Yishima7e, Ermaasa, Yahazi7eele, Yohanaane, Gadeere dere as Yozabaade,
El7uzaye, Yarmoote, Ba7aaliya, Shamaariya, Harife as Shafaaxiya,
Qoore as Hilqaana, Yishiya, Azari7eele, Yo7eezerenne Yashobi7aame,
Gadoore as Yirohaame naa Yo7eelenne Zabaadiya.
Gaade Zarkkefe Dawitekko Yida Ola Asata

Dawiti bazzon baqati attizason diza wode Gaade zarkketappe olanchchati izakko yida; isttika minonne olas giigettida asata; qasseka gondallenne toora oyth dandayzayta; istta ayfesoy gaammo mala babisees; istti zuma bolla guppiza genessa mala pilateettes.
Istta halaqay koyroyssi Eezere,
Hayti Gaade zarkketa garsan olanchchata halaqata; isttafe daroti shaalaqata mala, amardayti mato halaqata mala qoodettida.
Yordaanoose shaafay kixa salo shempida koyro aginan pinnidi zullaafe arshey mokkiza baggaranne arshey wulliza baggara dunkaani uttida asaa ubbaa yedeththida.
Biniyaame Zarkketappenne Yuhuda Zarkketappe Dawitekko Bida Olanchchata
Biniyaame zarkketappenne Yuhuda zarkketappe amarda asati Dawiti dizaso miixa yida.

Histtiin Dawiti isttara gayttana ke7idi, «Intte tana maaddanaas saron taakko yidaa gidikko ta inttena ufayssan mokka ekkana; gido attiin intte tana ta morkketas aaththi immanaas yidaa gidikko nu aawata Xoossay hayssa be7idi pirdo!» gides.
Hessafe guye 30 asata halaqa Amasaye bolla Xoossa Ayanay wodhdhiin
Hessa gishshas Dawiti mokki ekkidi ba olanchchata bolla halaqa histtides.
Minaase Zarkkefe Dawitekko Yida Asata

Dawiti Filisxeemetara issife gididi Sa7oole olanaas bida wode Minaase zarkkefe amarda asati Dawitekko biidi iza qoommida; gido attiin, «Dawitinne iza olanchchati istta kawoza Sa7ooles aaththi immanaakko» gi hirgida gishshas Filisxeeme asati keehi zorettidaappe guyen istta guye Xigilaage zaarida.
Dawiti Xigilaage katama simmishin iza maaddanaas Minaase zarkketappe kezi yida shaalaqati Adinahe, Yozabaade, Yidi7eele, Mika7eele, Yozabaade, Eelihunne Xiltaye.
Istti ubbatikka erettida mino olanchchata gidida gishshas Dawite ola wottadarata bolla halaqata gidida; Dawite morkketa olidi iza maaddida.
Dawite olanchchati Xoossa olanchchata mala corattana gakkanaas iza maaddiza asay gallas gallas gujettees.
Kebroonen Dawite Qoommida Olanchchata Qooda
GODAY immida hidota qaalaa mala Sa7oole kawoteththaa Dawites zaaranaas Dawitekko Kebroone yida ola tamaarda wottadarata qooday hayssafe kaallizayssa;
Gondallenne toora oykkidi olas giigettida Yuhuda zarkketi usuppun shiyanne osppun xeeta.
Simoona zarkkefe olas giigida minonne wolqqama olanchchati laappun shiyanne issi xeet.
Lewe zarkkefe oyddu shiyanne usuppun xeet,
Aaroone zarkketa halaqa Yoodahe gujjiin heedzdzu shiyanne laappun xeet.
Erettida olanchcha Saadooqe dabbota giddofe izara gujjiin nam7u tammanne nam7a.
Biniyaame zarkkefe Sa7oole dabboti heedzdzu shiya. Gido attiin Biniyaame zarkkefe dariza baggati Sa7oole keeththa asaas he wodey gakkanaas ammanettizayta.
Efreeme zarkkefe bantta aawata keeththan erettida minoti nam7u tammu shiyanne osppun xeet.
Dawite kawoththanaas doorettida Minaase zarkke baggaafe tammanne osppun shiya.
Isra7eele asay ay ooththanaas bessizaakko wodeza shaakki eriza aadho eranchchatinne Yisakoore zarkke halaqati nam7u xeet; isttara yida istta dabboti ubbay isttas azazetteettes.
Ola meezetidayti, ola massara ubbaan olettanaas dandayzaytinne wozinay ballatontta Dawite maaddanaas yida Zaabiloone baggati ichchash tammu shiya.
Niftaaleme zarkketas issi shiya halaqati deettes; gondallenne toora oykkida heedzdzu tammanne laappun shii asati isttara issife deettes.
Daane zarkkefe olas giigettida asati nam7u tammanne osppun shiyanne usuppun xeet.
Aaseere zarkkefe ola meezetidi giigettida olanchchati oyddu tammu shiya.
Yordaanoose shaafappe arshey mokkiza baggan diza Oroobeele zarkketappe, Gaade zarkketappenne Minaase zarkke baggaafe dumma dumma qommo massara oykkidi yida asati xeetanne nam7u tammu shiya.

Ha olas giigida olanchchati ubbay Dawite Isra7eele bolla kawoththanaas bantta qofaa issi bolla qachchidi Kebroone katama yida; qasse hankko attida Isra7eele dere ubbay Dawite kawoththanaas issi wozinan gidides.
Istta dabboti isttas koshshizayssa giigsi woththida gishshas mishenne uyishe Dawitekkon heedzdzu gallas gam7ida.

Isra7eele asaas gita ufays gidiza gishshas istta shooroppe doommidi haakon diza Yisakooreppe, Zaabilooneppenne Niftaalemeppe asay attontta kath, dhiille, balasenne zabibe kompa, woyne ushshinne wogara zayte haren, baqulon, gaamellaninne booran caanidi ehides; qasseka istti shukki maana mala miizatanne dorsata ekki yida.
